caption: The drawing features two juxtaposed objects resembling ornate metal spurs, each with a prominent ring at the top, oriented side by side. The object on the left is rendered in tones of brown and gray, with a patina suggesting aged or rusted metal. Its contours include curved and scalloped edges, and a smooth cylindrical part extends horizontally near the center. The bottom terminates in a hook-like structure with additional small circular detailing. The object on the right is more elaborate and depicted in shades of gray and silver, with intricate decorative elements. It features a prominent circular medallion filled with a star design and surrounded by raised dots, above a detailed bird in flight with visible feathers. Beneath the bird, a coiled rope-like band and a small circular hook are visible. The overall composition places the two spurs against a cream-colored background with no additional objects or scenery, and the name "HARRY MANN WADDELL" is written in small, uppercase text at the lower right.
title: Sultan's Bit
